name: Bullet Time
blurb: Time freezes; the camera keeps moving.

shots.action: Time freezes mid-movement: the dancer is locked perfectly still, every strand of hair and wisp of haze suspended in the air like glass, nothing in the frame moves except the camera.
shots.sound: A deep slowed-down rumble with a crystalline shimmer.
shots.cameraText: The camera travels in a wide, smooth arc around the frozen dancer, sweeping from her front to her side while she stays completely motionless
shots.framing: her profile against the red and blue light
